cases.title: Persistent note lifecycle
cases.expected: Saved bytes survive restart; append and delete succeed.
cases.observed: Exact bytes preserved across process restart; duplicate create rejected; deletion verified.

cases.title: Block/wake scheduling
cases.expected: WAITING excluded; wake appends exactly once.
cases.observed: P2 executes while P1 is WAITING; wake enqueues P1 once; duplicate wake rejected.

cases.title: Empty, single, and short burst
cases.observed: Empty run stays at tick 0; burst 1 with quantum 10 completes at tick 1.

cases.title: 20-task capacity
cases.observed: 20 records accepted; record 21 rejected; 20 payload bytes tracked before shutdown.

cases.title: Exact memory budget
cases.expected: 65,536 accepted; extra byte rejected; memory reclaimed.
cases.observed: 65,536-byte allocation accepted; extra byte rejected; completion returns usage to zero.

cases.title: Input validation
cases.expected: Invalid numeric, name, oversized commands leave no partial task.
cases.observed: 11 invalid/oversized commands rejected; next valid task gets P1; oversized tail discarded.

cases.title: File failure recovery
cases.observed: Missing/read/path/open errors recover; /dev/full write/close failure is reported.

cases.title: Invalid transitions and PIDs
cases.expected: Invalid transitions rejected without queue changes.
cases.observed: Unknown PIDs, wake READY, and block/wake FINISHED rejected; invariants hold.

cases.title: Forced allocation failure
cases.expected: No PID, task, queue, or memory counter committed.
cases.observed: Forced NULL leaves existing 10 bytes unchanged; next task gets P2 and runs normally.

cases.title: Memory lifecycle cleanup
cases.expected: Zero tracked payload bytes after completion/reset/exit.
cases.observed: Completion, reset with WAITING task, and exit with READY/WAITING tasks release all payloads.

cases.title: Study session completion
cases.expected: Exactly one notice on actual completion.
cases.observed: Three slices (2+2+1) complete at tick 5; console and event log each contain one notice.

core_output: CORE ASSERTIONS PASS: exact metrics, blocked wait, late arrivals, rollback, capacity, queue wrap, cleanup.
